title: Establish open-source repository and contribution governance
criteria: Publish Apache-2.0 for original material, NOTICE and third-party provenance boundaries.
Provide README, contribution, conduct, governance, security and support guides plus issue/PR templates.
Create main/develop, enable private vulnerability reporting and enforce passing checks plus one independent approval.
Verify bootstrap authorship uses the owner identity, and original prototype remains separate.

title: Verify Sign MT production access and service contract
criteria: Record authorized endpoint, access terms, quota/cost, retention and version policy.
Pin inspected source revision; document language identifiers, request schema, errors and response pose format.
Validate synthetic English-to-ASL requests; no real conversation input.
Record blockers explicitly; do not infer public API authorization from client code.

title: Audit prototype, dependencies and assets before source migration
criteria: Inventory candidate files with origin, author, license, modifications and redistribution obligations.
Identify original reusable code separately from Sign MT code/configuration and distribution archives.
Publish a reviewed import allowlist and required notices; no blanket Apache relicensing.

title: Validate offline English speech support on all platforms
criteria: Test representative Vision Pro, iPhone and iPad with local English recognition and network disabled.
Document minimum OS/hardware, asset downloads, denied permissions and unsupported-device behavior.
Publish capability matrix and reproduce a 30-minute offline session without cloud fallback.

title: Validate pose decoding and native rendering feasibility
criteria: Capture licensed synthetic fixtures and document coordinate system, timing, handedness and face/hand fields.
Establish byte/frame/allocation limits and reject malformed or non-finite values.
Demonstrate native playback feasibility on each platform; mark spike code as experimental.

title: Freeze caption and ASL evaluation protocol
criteria: Agree held-out caption corpus and ASL semantic categories with an ASL evaluation lead.
Define consent, compensation, recruitment, scoring and severe-error adjudication.
Approve or revise proposed numeric thresholds before measurement; record baseline and protocol version.

title: Create native Apple application targets and shared modules
criteria: Create iOS/iPadOS and visionOS targets with shared conversation, speech, translation and pose boundaries.
Import only approved original prototype files with provenance/history references and preserved notices.
Resolve local package paths and dependencies from a clean clone.
Document exact unsigned build commands and verified toolchain; no production web DOM bridge.

title: Add reproducible builds and behavior tests to CI
criteria: Build all platform targets and run package/app tests on runners with required runtimes.
Use least-privilege permissions, pinned actions and no secrets for untrusted fork PRs.
Make named build/test checks required once passing; attach failure artifacts without content or credentials.
Prove CI detects an intentionally failing behavior test before reverting the probe.

title: Implement isolated speech lifecycle and permission handling
criteria: Use one injectable microphone owner and bounded recognition stream with enforced on-device processing.
Test stop during authorization, stream finish/failure, duplicate starts and recognizer restarts.
Remove audio taps, end requests and deactivate owned audio resources on termination.
Request permissions in context; denied/restricted/unavailable states never start recording.

title: Implement finalized utterance identity and segmentation
criteria: Partial updates stay local and finalization deduplicates by session/utterance identity.
Apply approved 280-grapheme/15-second bounds without silent truncation or lost negation.
Exclude segments crossing transmission state boundaries, including delayed final callbacks.
Test Unicode, long speech, corrections and restart overlap using production components.

title: Enforce automatic ASL enable, pause and resume boundaries
criteria: Start captions with ASL off; explicit enable affects future wholly eligible utterances only.
Close dispatch gate before pause acknowledgement, invalidate epochs, cancel in-flight work and ignore late results.
Resume never uploads paused or pre-enable speech; stop and interruption cannot revive sessions.
Use deterministic race tests covering dispatch, callback, cancellation and multiple windows.

title: Implement typed Sign MT translation adapter
criteria: Encode approved English/ASL contract and decode bounded responses into typed results.
Handle timeout, 429/Retry-After, authorization, malformed data and allowed HTTPS redirects.
No fallback provider or automatic resubmission; use synthetic contract fixtures and cancellable requests.
Exclude transcript-bearing URLs and bodies from logs, diagnostics and disk caches.

title: Bound translation and playback queues end to end
criteria: At most two utterances await first frame including queued/in-flight/ready work; at most one request and one ready pose.
Expire waiting work at ten seconds from finalization, ignore late results and mark every omission.
Preserve order without interrupting active signed phrases; reject incoming work when capacity is full.
Test slow service, slow playback, burst input, expiry and resume; include queue wait in latency.

title: Implement native skeleton playback with local replay
criteria: Preserve verified timing, handedness and available non-manual data on all platforms.
Reject invalid/oversized poses and prevent cropped signing space.
Provide pause and local replay without network calls.
Budget active pose, one ready pose and one replay result; do not evict unplayed work silently.

title: Implement disclosures and visible transmission controls
criteria: Distinguish local captions, online transmission, paused, unavailable and interrupted states with text and symbols.
Disclose provider, text sent, retention and already-sent request limitation before enabling ASL.
Expose Pause ASL, Resume ASL and End Conversation as distinct accessible actions.
Verify ordinary failures use actionable inline feedback and never re-enable transmission automatically.

title: Enforce ephemeral content and diagnostic redaction
criteria: Bound transcript memory to latest ten minutes or 200 utterances and poses to approved memory budget.
Clear conversation content and temporary files on end; no persistent URL cache, cloud sync or clipboard writes.
Redact app-switcher previews and inspect app/crash/network diagnostics for content leakage.
Use synthetic sentinel transcripts to test log, cache and file paths.

title: Build readable live captions and modality selection
criteria: Render stable partial/final utterances without duplicates, preserving reader scroll position.
Offer return-to-live, adjustable caption text and captions/signs/both modes.
Hidden captions remain available and processing is independent of translation connectivity.
Test largest accessibility text sizes and screen-reader focus under continuous updates.

title: Build adaptive iPhone conversation experience
criteria: Provide reachable session controls in portrait and landscape with safe-area compliance.
Support native controls, 44-point touch targets, semantic colors and no clipped content at maximum text sizes.
Validate full start/enable/pause/replay/end flow on minimum and representative current hardware.

title: Build resizable iPad conversation experience
criteria: Adapt content and controls across supported narrow/wide windows and orientations.
Support hardware keyboard, pointer, VoiceOver and Switch Control without gesture-only actions.
Preserve one session while resizing and maintain visible pause control.

title: Build native Vision Pro conversation windows
criteria: Use adjustable user-positioned windows without required immersive space or person tracking.
Verify gaze/pinch operation, signing distance, window size and physical conversation visibility.
Additional windows share one microphone/session and cannot revive ended sessions.
Record physical Vision Pro usability and comfort checks.

title: Validate background, audio-route and interruption recovery
criteria: Stop capture/transmission on background, lock and interruption; require explicit restart.
Test audio route change, permission revocation, window closure and repeated rapid stop/start.
No orphan microphone, task, request, stale output or duplicated caption remains.

title: Audit complete accessibility flows across all platforms
criteria: Measure conversation text contrast at least 4.5:1 and verify largest Dynamic Type without clipping.
Complete core flow using VoiceOver, Switch Control and supported keyboard/pointer/gaze input.
Respect reduced motion/transparency; preserve meaningful signing with explicit pause and caption alternative.
Record findings and close every critical/high accessibility defect.

title: Benchmark offline caption accuracy and latency
criteria: Evaluate held-out utterances and varied speakers under specified quiet/noise conditions.
Measure WER, word-end-to-partial p95, cold start and 30-minute offline behavior per platform.
Publish aggregate evidence with denominators, versions and failures, without participant content.

title: Validate ASL skeleton comprehension with Deaf fluent users
criteria: Evaluate 120 held-out messages with at least eight fluent Deaf ASL participants and three evaluations per message.
Test signs without captions first; score categories and adjudicate severe meaning reversals.
Meet approved comprehension gates or block ASL release and record remediation.
Publish consented aggregate findings, uncertainty and limitations; protect participant identity.

title: Run sustained-use, latency and beta reliability validation
criteria: Measure first-frame latency including playback wait, timeout/error/omission rates and approved service quota.
Run 30-minute hardware sessions, inspect thermal/memory/battery behavior and ≥200 consented beta sessions.
Count failures and queue drops, document sample limitations and resolve blocking defects.

title: Document service outage, security and release response
criteria: Reproduce outages with synthetic inputs and provide captions-only recovery.
Document maintainer support, content-free monitoring, provider-change revalidation and ASL disable/rollback procedure.
Verify feature gates never enable transmission without user action; run an outage drill.

title: Review licensing, privacy and distribution readiness
criteria: Reconcile Apache originals and all retained notices against final file/dependency inventory.
Confirm provider rights/retention, required privacy manifests and accurate store disclosures.
Record owner decisions on distribution territories and monetization before submission.
Do not claim local-only processing for text that is sent to Sign MT.

title: Publish reproducible setup, real screenshots and release evidence
criteria: Validate setup from a clean checkout and update exact platform build/test commands.
Capture real approved-device screenshots using synthetic content and explain current limitations.
Link architecture, tested support matrix, accessibility/ASL evidence and contributor entry points.

title: Complete release checklist and reviewed develop-to-main promotion
criteria: Link evidence for every P0 and all unresolved risks; no critical/high blocker remains.
Require independent approval and successful checks on release candidate.
Prepare chore: release PR from develop to main and use merge commit, without tags.
Do not merge or submit an app automatically as part of issue creation.

title: Add explicit caption correction and resubmission
criteria: Editing never silently uploads text; explicit resubmission targets selected utterance.
Identify corrected results and test stale responses against the corrected revision.

title: Add validated signing playback-rate controls
criteria: Evaluate intelligibility at each offered rate and retain tested normal default.
Rate changes preserve timing/order and do not alter transmission state.

title: Design opt-in local history and export
criteria: Separate privacy review defines retention, protection, deletion and export preview.
Default remains ephemeral; enabling history requires explicit consent and tests.

title: Evaluate offline ASL inference with Core ML
criteria: Identify licensed model/data and demonstrate reproducible conversion and supported operations.
Benchmark memory, energy, thermal behavior and latency on supported device classes.
Meet ASL comprehension gate; offline mode never silently changes to remote inference.

title: Evaluate German to Swiss-German Sign Language
criteria: Confirm target language/variant with community and verify provider/model coverage.
Establish licensed datasets and independent pair-specific evaluation before support claims.

title: Evaluate Russian to Russian Sign Language
criteria: Confirm target variant, corpus rights and provider/model support.
Define fluent-user evaluation and verified language-pair capability gating.

title: Define Uzbek input and local signed-language support with community
criteria: Work with intended Deaf users in Uzbekistan to define signed language and variant.
Do not infer equivalence to Russian Sign Language; establish model/data rights and evaluation.

title: Evaluate human-like signing avatar
criteria: Verify rig/asset licenses and preservation of manual/non-manual linguistic features.
Demonstrate comprehension improvement against skeleton baseline before replacement.

title: Specify sign-to-spoken bidirectional translation
criteria: Create separate capture/privacy requirements and verify platform camera/import support.
Evaluate licensed sign-video inference with fluent users and define accuracy/failure gates.
